metadata.title: BAS District
metadata.description: An isometric city of citizen NFTs, shown with mock data.

city.eventBody: Craft fixes the generator, Bond calms the crowd, Insight finds the cause.
city.blockedMessage: {name} cannot enter {district} yet. It opens at {rule}.
city.notOwnedMessage: Only citizens you own follow your taps. Pick one under My citizens.

profile.title: CITIZEN PROFILE
profile.talkMessage: Chat with citizens arrives in Stage 5. In this preview they only walk and work.
profile.missing: This citizen is not in the preview roster.

missions.title: MISSION BOARD
missions.subtitle: Central Plaza
missions.note: Credits from missions are the only way to train
missions.rewardNote: Goes to {name} only and cannot be traded. One credit plus {cost} {symbol} trains {stat} {from} → {to}.
missions.verified: The mission server checks each step, then co-signs the credit on chain.
missions.completeMessage: {name} earned 1 {stat} credit and {points} season points. Spend the credit in Training.
missions.selectHint: Pick a mission to see its steps.

streetLamp.title: Fix the street lamp
streetLamp.body: The lamp by the east road went dark. Bring the parts to the workshop and fit them in the right order.

steps.title: Pick up parts at the market
steps.hint: Walk to the market stall by the notice board in Central Plaza.

steps.title: Walk to the workshop
steps.hint: Carry the parts to the workshop door in Forge Yard.

steps.title: Fit the parts in order
steps.prompt: Build the lamp from the bottom up: the base plate holds the wire, the wire powers the bulb, and the glass goes over the bulb.

lightsOut.title: Who turned off the lights?
lightsOut.body: Collect clues from the city ledger and the citizens, then name the culprit.

steps.title: Read the city ledger
steps.hint: Walk to the ledger desk in front of the Archive.

steps.title: Ask the night clerk
steps.prompt: The ledger says the lights went out at midnight. What do you ask the night clerk?
options: Who walked past the lamp at midnight?

steps.title: Name the culprit
steps.prompt: The clerk saw a cart hit the lamp post, and the forge cart was out late. Who turned off the lights?

hearthDeliveries.title: Deliveries for Hearth Row
hearthDeliveries.body: Collect the parcels, bring them to the homes and calm an upset neighbour.

steps.title: Collect the parcels
steps.hint: Pick up the parcels on the east side of Central Plaza.

steps.title: Deliver to the homes
steps.hint: Walk the parcels to the homes in Hearth Row.

steps.title: Calm the neighbour
steps.prompt: A neighbour is upset their parcel came late. What do you say?
options: Sorry for the wait. I came as fast as I could, and it is all here.
Take it up with the post office.

nightPatrol.title: Night patrol
nightPatrol.body: Check three posts on the wall and report the one thing out of place.

steps.title: North post
steps.hint: Walk to the north post of Watchtower Gate.

steps.title: East post
steps.hint: Walk along the wall to the east post.

steps.title: Gate post
steps.hint: Finish the round at the post beside the gate.

steps.title: Report what was odd
steps.prompt: Which one did not belong on the wall tonight?
options: A lit torch at the north post
A guard at the east post
An open gate latch at the gate post

ruinsExpedition.title: Expedition to the ruins
ruinsExpedition.body: Pack supplies, cross the gate and map the ruins beyond the wall.

steps.title: Pack supplies
steps.hint: Collect supplies on the south side of Central Plaza.

steps.title: Cross the gate
steps.hint: Walk through the gate into the Outer Frontier.

steps.title: Reach the ruins
steps.hint: Walk to the old ruins deep in the frontier.

steps.title: Map the ruins
steps.prompt: Draw the map from the gate outward: the old road leads from the gate to the broken tower, and the vault lies past the tower.

blackoutNight.title: Blackout Night
blackoutNight.body: Every stat has a job: fix the generator, calm the crowd, find the cause.

steps.title: Fix the generator
steps.prompt: Restart the generator safely: open the fuel first, then start it, and switch the main breaker on last.

steps.title: Calm the crowd
steps.prompt: The plaza is dark and people are worried. What do you say?
options: Stay together, the lights will be back in minutes.

steps.title: Find the cause
options: An overloaded line at the forge

missions.stepGoto: Walk {name} to the marker on the map.
missions.stepPuzzle: Tap the pieces in the right order.
missions.limits: {left} of {max} mission credits left today for {name}
missions.cooldownHint: {name} already finished this mission today. It opens again tomorrow.
missions.limitHint: {name} has earned {max} mission credits today. Come back tomorrow.
missions.citizenBusyHint: {name} is on another mission. Finish or abandon it first.
missions.nextDayHint: Mock only: moves the season clock one day to reset the daily limits.
missions.wrongAnswer: That is not it. Read the question again and pick another reply.
missions.wrongOrder: Wrong order. The pieces were put back, try again.

training.title: TRAINING
training.subtitle: Spend one credit and burn {symbol} to raise one stat by 1
training.head: {stat} {from} → {to}
training.reachesTier: Reaches Tier {tier} and unlocks new content
training.ladderNote: Bar = cost to reach that score. 100 at 1, up to 1,000 at 10.
training.mockNote: Mock mode: nothing is signed or burned. With a wallet this sends one upgrade_score transaction.
training.speechTier: One more {stat} and I reach Tier {tier}. Let's go.
training.speechMaxed: My {stat} is already at the top.
training.notYours: {name} belongs to another player. Pick one of your citizens to train.

season.title: SEASON {number}
season.subtitle: Day {day} of {length} · ends in {left} days
season.entries: {entries} valid entries → up to {winners} cash winners
season.noBoard: The leaderboard for this bracket opens when it has five valid entries.
season.previewOnly: This preview has leaderboard rows for the Skilled bracket only.
season.cutline: CASH PRIZES STOP AT RANK {rank} · ACHIEVEMENT TITLES CONTINUE
season.rules: Points reset each season. Scores, achievements and history stay with the citizen. One wallet enters one citizen per competition.
season.disclosure: Funded only by Pump.fun creator fees under a locked 50 / 30 / 20 split. Prize amounts are not guaranteed. Holding a citizen does not earn rewards.
season.explorerMessage: This vault is mock data. The real address appears here after the prize_vault program is deployed.

not-owner.title: NOT YOUR CITIZEN
not-owner.message: Only the owner of a citizen can train it or take missions with it.

stat-at-max.title: STAT AT MAXIMUM
stat-at-max.message: This stat is already at 10, the highest score.

no-credit.title: NO CREDIT
no-credit.message: Training needs one credit of the same stat. Finish a mission to earn one.

insufficient-balance.title: NOT ENOUGH TOKENS
insufficient-balance.message: The wallet does not hold enough tokens for this training.

district-locked.title: DISTRICT LOCKED
district-locked.message: This citizen cannot enter that district yet.

mission-busy.title: MISSION TAKEN
mission-busy.message: Another of your citizens is already on this mission.

mission-closed.title: NOT OPEN YET
mission-closed.message: This mission cannot be started yet.

citizen-busy.title: ALREADY ON A MISSION
citizen-busy.message: This citizen is on another mission. Finish or abandon it first.

mission-cooldown.title: DONE TODAY
mission-cooldown.message: This citizen already finished this mission today. It opens again tomorrow.

daily-limit.title: DAILY LIMIT
daily-limit.message: A citizen earns up to 3 mission credits per day. Come back tomorrow.

invalid-stat.title: WRONG CREDIT
invalid-stat.message: This mission does not give a credit for that stat.

actions.walletMessage: This preview uses a mock wallet with mock tokens. Wallet connection arrives with the devnet step.
